source_of_truth: Parent roadmap 2026-05-23-003 defines the visual operating console strategy. V0 is explicitly audience-locked to the operator actively driving DontPanic work and must answer 'what needs action now?' from governed local state without Firebase.

user_journeys.name: operator-with-stale-capabilities-opens-dashboard-sees-actionable-items
user_journeys.description: An operator with incomplete or stale capability setup opens the local dashboard and sees a first-viewport action list naming the blocked/needs-setup capabilities, exact next commands, and human-required steps without configuring Firebase.
acceptance_signals: What Now view renders capability ActionItems from the local capability status cache
Each item maps to one of the four status bands
No Firebase config or auth is needed

user_journeys.name: operator-runs-action-sees-dashboard-reflect-it-without-manual-rebuild
user_journeys.description: An operator runs a DontPanic action in another terminal while `dontpanic dashboard serve` is running. The local console refreshes from files/cache without requiring a manual rebuild command.
acceptance_signals: State refresh happens through watch or periodic rebuild
The what-now cache changes after source state changes
No remote interface is exposed by default

user_journeys.name: operator-clicks-needs-setup-card-gets-copyable-commands
user_journeys.description: An operator expands or reviews a needs-action card and sees a human-readable label plus the exact CLI command or setup command to run next.
acceptance_signals: Automatable and human-required labels are visible

user_journeys.name: operator-with-zero-drift-sees-quiet-dashboard-not-noise
user_journeys.description: An operator whose gates are clear, capabilities are ready or optional, reconcile is clean, and supervisors are healthy sees a quiet, restrained dashboard rather than a wall of empty warning cards.
acceptance_signals: What Now view has a compact healthy state
Optional missing data does not render as a blocker
The four-band taxonomy has no red/needs_action items

user_journeys.name: agent-reads-dashboard-cache-and-gets-same-action-shape
user_journeys.description: An agent reads the dashboard what-now cache file and receives the same ActionItem JSON shape that powers the dashboard, so it can summarize outstanding human work without scraping HTML.
acceptance_signals: Cache file exists after dashboard build/serve
Cache contains schema_version and ActionItem array
No secret values appear in cache

non_goals: No plans/features roster in V0 beyond action context
No hosted dashboard or control plane
No secret storage or secret display
completion_test: A local operator runs `dontpanic dashboard serve`, opens the dashboard, and sees a first-viewport What Now view sourced from gates, capabilities, reconcile drift, and active supervisors. It refreshes after local state changes, displays exact copyable commands, renders a quiet healthy state when no actions exist, and writes an agent-readable cache with the same ActionItem shape. Doctor and init point to the dashboard. Firebase is not required.
